_comment: In-process local LLM models (docs/adr/0025). Loaded by `lashon-core::llm::local::LocalLlmProvider` via mistralrs. Apache-2.0 / MIT only — anything else is opt-in with a non-commercial badge, per the wake-classifier precedent (docs/adr/0016). Files are downloaded on first use; the SHA-256 is verified on every load (docs/adr/0010). The `sha256` and `bytes` fields are mirrored from the upstream Hugging Face LFS pointer (the `oid sha256:…` and `size` lines of the .gguf's LFS metadata); whoever bumps the manifest entry refreshes both in the same commit.

models.description: Default pick. ~2.5 GB on disk, ~3.5 GB warm RAM. Reliably completes multi-step interactive tool chains (open app → quick switcher → type recipient → enter → type message → enter) that the smaller 1.7B variant kept dropping mid-flow. Runs on any modern GPU via Vulkan; CPU fallback works on 8 GB systems but is slow.

Faster, lighter — ~1.83 GB on disk, ~2 GB warm RAM. Use on very weak hardware where the 4B variant is too slow. Not recommended for messaging-app or other multi-step tool chains; the smaller model regularly stops mid-flow.
